Description: Arduino Nano v3 (ATmega328P), on 2 x 15 female headers
Bulk capacitor, 12 V rail, 105 C electrolytic
Ceramic 100 nF: decoupling (C2, C3, C6, C9, C10) and button filter (C7)
Electrolytic, 5 V rail
Flow signal filter capacitor
Receiver supply filter, electrolytic
Reverse-polarity crowbar (D1) and valve flyback diode (D2), SMD 1N5408 (SMC)
25 L limit indicator: panel LED (plain, no built-in resistor), JST-XH 2-pin lead
50 L limit indicator: panel LED (plain, no built-in resistor), JST-XH 2-pin lead
100 L limit indicator: panel LED (plain, no built-in resistor), JST-XH 2-pin lead
PCB holder for standard ATO/ATC blade fuses (Keystone 3557-2) + 2 A blade fuse
12 V DC supply input: 1 = +12 V, 2 = GND. 2-way 5.08 mm screw terminal
Main (rocker) switch: 1 = fused 12 V to the switch, 2 = switched 12 V back, 3 = GND for the switch lamp
1 = valve + (switched 12 V), 2 = GND (valve - and sensor black), 3 = +5V (sensor red), 4 = sensor signal (yellow). 4-way 5.08 mm screw terminal
ESP32-C3-Zero link: 1 = +5V (ESP 5V pin), 2 = GND, 3 = data to ESP (3.3 V, ESP RX, GPIO20), 4 = data from ESP (ESP TX, GPIO21). JST-XH 4-pin
Panel push button (MODE / CAL): 1 = button, 2 = GND. JST-XH 2-pin
Panel LED for the 25 L limit: 1 = LED + (anode), 2 = LED - (cathode). JST-XH 2-pin
Panel LED for the 50 L limit: 1 = LED + (anode), 2 = LED - (cathode). JST-XH 2-pin
Panel LED for the 100 L limit: 1 = LED + (anode), 2 = LED - (cathode). JST-XH 2-pin
High-side P-MOSFET valve switch (DPAK, -55 V, -31 A, 65 mOhm)
Logic-level N-MOSFET that drives the Q1 gate
Pull-ups: flow signal (R1), button (R3), Q1 gate (R18); Q2 gate pull-down (R20)
Series resistors: flow signal (R2), remote channels (R7-R10), data from the ESP (R21)
LED current limit, about 9 mA
Data to ESP divider (top)
Data to ESP divider (bottom), 5 V -> 3.24 V
Remote channel pull-down
Receiver supply filter resistor
Q2 gate resistor
Panel momentary push button (normally open), with a JST-XH 2-pin lead to J5
Illuminated SPST rocker switch, 12 V lamp, rated 5 A or more (panel mount)
5 V regulator, TO-220 pinout IN-GND-OUT: R-78E5.0-1.0 switcher (recommended, runs cool), or L7805 with a heatsink
RX480E-4 receiver module on a 1x7 female header. Pins: 1 GND, 2 +V, 3-6 D0-D3, 7 VT
Sockets for the Nano. Solder the parts that sit under the Nano first
Socket for the RX480E-4 receiver module
Standard automotive blade fuse for the F1 holder
ESP32 link lead
Leads to the panel button and LEDs
Only needed with an L7805; fits the marked area (18 x 19 mm)
Mounting
